notes.title: Small Patch for September 25 2025.
notes.content:
Added a tool tip system for single player maps.

Added support for headless dedicated server with command line startup options(more information in the support folder).

Fixed a bug preventing the "Badlands Pit" achievement to unlock.

notes.title: New Multiplayer Map: Street Court!
notes.content: [p]In this update:[/p][p]Added Street Court, a new multiplayer map, and a new achievement![/p][p]High Scores will now be recorded in single player modes.[/p][p]Various fixes to network code, Super Move Meter,  and UI.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313916/37622bb5c1ec3948b2a581cdd1b34aff3d8ab682.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Multiplayer Map Release
notes.content: [p]Added the Badlands Pit Multiplayer Map, two new achievements and other small fixes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313916/d600886b6d54bb569d6b6c1648b7d66a2e79b253.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Single Player map: Catch Practice!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313916/a7e217be653fc5db81272e8a4f38eebca9b0d76b.jpg[/img]

Practice catching balls shot from a hovering cannon!  This map comes with new achievements to unlock!

notes.title: New Single Player Map Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313916/b89120d1c0cc562266ac967a25b185bb980cd603.jpg[/img]

Hit the moving targets and see how many points you can score!  This map also features new achievements for you to unlock!

notes.title: Update notes for December 9, 2024
notes.content: Fixed a bug that prevented Achievements from being unlocked.
